description.zh-CN: 任务控制台视角的行星轨道。桌面上的散落文件是太空碎片，开着的应用是轨道卫星，CPU 是反应堆，电量是能源。
description.en: A planet seen from mission control. Loose desktop files drift as space debris, open apps circle as satellites, the CPU is the reactor and the battery is power.

concept.world: Mission control watching a quiet planet: orbits, satellites, a debris field, telemetry.
concept.mood: Calm, precise, nocturnal. Thin lines, monospace, one cyan accent, amber only for warnings.
concept.type: A monospace face in capitals for instrument labels, with small Chinese subtitles when the user reads Chinese.
concept.motion: Everything orbits at its own slow speed; the star field drifts in parallax. Actions are captures, launches and shutdowns, never flashes.

metaphors.tidy-files.pending: Each loose file on the desktop is one speck of debris
metaphors.tidy-files.run: CAPTURE DEBRIS 收拢碎片: each filed document is pulled into the archive orbit
metaphors.tidy-files.undo: RELEASE 释放: the captured objects drift back out
metaphors.tidy-files.open: ARCHIVE BAY 档案舱: open the folder where they were filed
metaphors.quit-apps.open: Each open app is a satellite with its light on
metaphors.quit-apps.run: SILENT RUNNING 静默航行: satellites go dark one by one as apps close
metaphors.quit-apps.reopen: WAKE ALL 全部唤醒: the lights come back
metaphors.clock: Mission clock with the day of the year
